name: context-band
description: Band above the prompt: context zone, a Panel pane toggle, and a one-press Handoff with a rolling draft.

handoffFrom.title: Handoff from (tokens)
handoffFrom.description: Show the zone label and Handoff button from this many tokens. Below it, the band shows only the count.

paneCommand.title: Pane command
paneCommand.description: Command the Panel button runs, without the slash.

yellowAt.title: Yellow at (tokens)
yellowAt.description: Plan a handoff from this many tokens.

redAt.title: Red at (tokens)
redAt.description: Hand off now from this many tokens.

stashCommand.title: Stash command
stashCommand.description: Skill the Handoff button runs, without the slash.

resumeCommand.title: Resume command
resumeCommand.description: Skill that resumes the stash after /clear, without the slash.

limitsFrom.title: Usage limits from (%)
limitsFrom.description: Show a 5-hour or weekly usage limit once it passes this percent.

draftEvery.title: Draft every (turns)
draftEvery.description: Update the rolling handoff draft after this many turns, and on each zone change.

draftModel.title: Draft model
draftModel.description: Model that writes the rolling draft.
